content: Competitor feature matrix: Money Manager (RealByte, Play Store listing Aug 2026): double-entry accounts, budgets, recurring/automatic transfers, credit card mgmt, passcode, bookmark templates, backup to Excel, search page, batch edit, quick-add widgets, filters, calendar, charts, receipt photos. YNAB (features page 2026): bank import, multi-device sync incl offline, subscription sharing for 6, goal targets, loan calculator, spending/net-worth reports, category templates, widgets, 2FA. Spendee (site): bank/crypto/e-wallet connect, shared wallets, smart budgets, custom categories + photo + location per expense, multi-currency, alerts/reminders, sync, charts. Bluecoins (site): multi-currency, accounts, CSV import+export (transactions/reminders/balance sheet), Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive sync, local backup, bank SMS import, reminders, batch multi-select, dashboard customization.
